description: send in my own meter reading
utterances: here's my electric reading, where do i put it in
Nobody has come to check the dial in months and I don't want another estimate, so I took a photo of the numbers and want to give them to you.

description: challenge an estimated reading on my bill
utterances: you guessed my usage and guessed way too high
The figure on my latest statement is marked as an estimate and it's nearly double what the dial actually shows, I want it corrected to the real number.

description: arrange a visit to read the meter
utterances: can you send someone to check the gauge, i can't reach it
My meter is in a locked cupboard in the basement that I can't access, could a member of staff come by and take the numbers themselves?

description: report a meter that seems faulty or stuck
utterances: the numbers on my gas dial haven't moved in weeks
The display on my electricity unit is blank and the little wheel isn't spinning even with everything switched on, I think it has stopped working.

description: have the meter moved to another spot
utterances: we're extending the kitchen, the gauge is in the way
We're renovating and the box on the outside wall sits exactly where the new extension will go, what does it take to get it relocated?

description: see my current bill and usage breakdown
utterances: how much do i owe this quarter
I want to look at what I'm being charged this period and how it splits between electricity and gas before the due date.

description: question why my bill is much higher than usual
utterances: my bill tripled and nothing changed at home
This month's statement is far above anything I've paid before, we haven't bought new appliances or changed our habits, so something must be wrong.

description: spread an overdue balance over installments
utterances: behind on payments, can i pay it off bit by bit
I owe a few months' worth and can't cover it in one go, would you let me set up a schedule of smaller amounts until it's cleared?

description: change the address my bills go to
utterances: send my statements to my new place from now on
I've moved but I'm keeping the supply at the rental property I own, so the paperwork needs to come to where I actually live now.

description: switch from quarterly to monthly bills
utterances: can i get charged every month instead of every three
The big statement every quarter is hard to budget for, I'd much rather receive a smaller one each month so it's more predictable.

description: get a copy of an old bill
utterances: need last year's statements for my tax stuff
My landlord is asking for proof of what I paid over the previous twelve months, could you resend the invoices from that period?

description: report the electricity is out at my home
utterances: whole house just went dark, nothing works
We lost all electricity about an hour ago, the breaker panel looks fine and the neighbors seem to be out as well, is this a known problem?

description: report power that flickers or partially works
utterances: lights keep dimming and coming back every few minutes
Some outlets in the house have power and others don't, and the ones that work keep cutting in and out, so I'm worried something is wrong with the supply.

description: report there is no water coming out
utterances: turned on the tap and nothing came out
There's been no supply to the whole house since early this morning, every faucet is dry and I haven't had any notice of works.

description: report weak water pressure at home
utterances: shower is barely a trickle these days
For the last week the flow from every tap has been really weak, it takes ages to fill a kettle and the upstairs bathroom is almost unusable.

description: report water that looks or smells wrong
utterances: the water's coming out brown, is it safe
Since yesterday what comes out of our taps has a yellowish tint and a strange chemical smell, I want to know whether we should stop drinking it.

description: report a smell of gas in the house
utterances: i can smell gas in the kitchen, what do i do
There's a strong rotten egg odor near the boiler that's getting worse, I've opened the windows and turned off the appliances, please send someone urgently.

description: report the gas supply has stopped
utterances: hob won't light and the boiler's dead too
None of our gas appliances will ignite since this morning, there's no smell of anything, it just seems like nothing is coming through the pipe at all.

description: ask about scheduled maintenance work in my area
utterances: is there planned work on my street this week
I got a leaflet saying supply might be interrupted for maintenance soon, can you tell me the exact day and how long we'll be without it?

description: get supply restored after it was cut off
utterances: paid what i owed, when does the power come back on
You disconnected my electricity last week over the unpaid balance, I've settled it in full now and need it switched back on as soon as possible.

description: temporarily shut off supply during building work
utterances: builders need the water off for a few days
We're replacing all the pipework in the house next month and the contractor wants the mains isolated for about a week while they work.

description: contest a disconnection warning i received
utterances: got a letter saying you'll cut me off but i've paid
A final warning arrived today threatening to stop my supply for non payment, but my account is up to date and I have the receipts to prove it.

description: set up supply at a home i am moving into
utterances: moving in on the first, need the power and water on
I'm taking over a flat that's been empty for a while and want electricity and gas active in my name from the day I get the keys.

description: close my account because i am moving out
utterances: leaving this house next week, stop billing me after that
My tenancy ends at the end of the month and I want to give you a final reading and make sure nothing more is charged to me afterwards.

description: put the account in a different person's name
utterances: my husband passed away, the account's in his name
My flatmate who set everything up is moving out and I'm staying, so the supply agreement needs to be switched over to me instead of him.

description: report a water leak in the street
utterances: water's gushing out of the pavement outside my house
There's been a steady stream running down the road from a crack near the curb for two days now, it looks like a burst main.

description: report a leak on my side of the meter
utterances: there's a wet patch in the garden that never dries
The pipe between the stopcock at the boundary and my kitchen seems to be leaking underground, my usage has shot up and the lawn is soggy.

description: report a fallen or damaged power line
utterances: a cable came down in the storm, it's lying across the road
A tree branch has pulled the overhead wire down onto my driveway and it's sparking, I've kept everyone away, please send a crew immediately.

description: book an annual gas appliance safety check
utterances: time for the yearly boiler check, can i book it
I rent out a property and the certificate for the heating system expires soon, I need an engineer to come and do the inspection before then.

description: report sewage backing up or a blocked drain
utterances: the drain outside is overflowing and it stinks
Wastewater is coming back up through the manhole cover in our front yard whenever it rains, the smell is awful and it's spreading onto the path.

description: request a brand new supply connection for a building
utterances: building a house on an empty plot, need it hooked up
We've got planning permission for a new build on land that has never had services, what's involved in getting electricity and water brought to the site?

description: apply for a reduced rate for low income households
utterances: i'm on benefits, is there a cheaper rate for me
I'm a pensioner living alone and struggling to keep up with the heating costs this winter, are there any discounted schemes I could qualify for?
